verdict.rationale: Qdrant is a vector database rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server documented on Qdrant's own site (qdrant.tech/documentation/qdrant-mcp-server/), which is the core of the story, though the pack contains only that one-line confirmation. Missing for 10: details of exposed tools and capabilities, transport and setup/configuration docs for connecting agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
